title: Decode mouse social competition outcomes
input_description: Aligned cortical calcium signals from both mice in a tube-test trial.
output_description: One predicted winner identity for each trial; the evaluator converts identities to fixed binary labels.
native_split_description: The released pipeline splits trials but fits scaling/PCA on full recordings before extracting them. A new BPB session- or pair-grouped split requires original signals, winner labels and stable trial identities; an official new Test release is not required.
reason: Only 17 processed validation examples are available in the inspected archive and source history. Original tube-test signals, trial times and stable identities are missing; repartitioning the cache cannot undo whole-recording PCA fitting.
